Infer which coarse cells in that stripe belong by comparing the repeated tile’s occupied-cell pattern to the visible coarse map; clear the 3 stripe and restore the tile at the corresponding occupied positions. Recolor each tile’s microcell matching its coarse row/column coordinate to 8 (e.g. coarse cell (i,j) gets microcell (i,j)); ensure that position is occupied in the tile. Demo confirmed for 3x3 and 4x4 self-similar patterns. Key caution: tiles may be offset/irregularly spaced in some variants, so infer tile bounds and coarse coordinates from repeated geometry rather than assuming fixed positions blindly.',global_=True)
print(mem)
